name: Darien Parks & Recreation Youth Summer Camps
description_short: The Town of Darien runs four youth day camps grouped by the grade a child enters in the fall: Stony Brook Camp (Grade 1), Settlers Camp (Grades 2-3) and Mather Camp (Grades 4-6) at Tokeneke Elementary School, and Middle School Camp (Grades 7-9) at The Depot. Camp runs 8:30am-3:00pm, June 21 to July 30, 2027, booked by the week; Middle School Camp meets Monday to Thursday.

sources.note: Grades are the grade entered in fall 2027. Phone and ZIP are Darien Town Hall's (2 Renshaw Road, Darien, CT 06820), shown on this page. Registration opens Feb 10, 2027 after a required prerequisite form.
Six weekly sessions June 21-July 30, 2027; no camp Monday July 5. Middle School Camp runs Monday-Thursday each week. 2027 fees not posted.
